positive_terms: Disclosure of whether and how policy adresses the use and sourcing of water and marine resources in own operations
水及海洋资源使用采购政策
Disclosure of whether and how policy adresses the use and sourcing of water and marine resources in own operations。水及海洋资源使用采购政策。水管理、取用采购、水处理、污染预防、风险区减量及海洋保护分开。高水压力区域未采纳政策的说明不能当作集团全部无政策。
